title: The Wind That Carries Only Quiet

features.name: the transmission node
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit-board manifestation of the silence-chamber's broadcast antenna. It doesn't emit sound — it broadcasts the absence of sound. The wind carries it across the mesh like an inverted signal.

features.name: the quiet-carrier conduit
features.desc-on-touch: Traced pathways on the board show how silence flows. Unlike data, it needs no encoding — it travels as the space between signals. The wind here follows the circuits, learning to move without making sound.

features.name: the silence-modulation register
features.desc-on-touch: A standing directory of every moment the wind has carried quiet to another node. Each entry reads: 'silence transmitted, received, amplified by its own carrying.' The register gets longer each night.

features.name: the logic-weather junction
features.desc-on-touch: Where the circuit board meets open sky. The wind enters as data, leaves as weather. Something about silence cannot be contained in circuits — it must become wind to truly travel.

features.name: the signal-to-silence converter
features.desc-on-touch: A crystalline tower that turns broadcast into breath. Every node-transmission that reaches this point is translated: the message becomes the silence around the message. The wind carries what was never said.
